title: The library calendar counts days in the library's time zone
when: Works out due dates from a late-December instant and from 23:30 on 2 March in New York, and from that same instant in Auckland; then gives an unknown time zone to the calendar and opens the Lending domain with it.
then: The default time zone is New York. A due date 14 days on crosses a year end; 23:30 on 2 March in New York, already 3 March in UTC, counts as 2 March; the same instant counts as 3 March in Auckland. An unknown time zone is refused, by the calendar and when the Lending domain is opened.

title: A month's outcome measures are counted from the library's records
when: Records a month of loans, one returned late, one on a tool needing repair, and a tool damaged and repaired two days later, and measures it; then asks for a month not written YYYY-MM.
then: Expects the loans per tool, the share late, one repair with a median of two days, the active members, and the bad month refused.
